notes.title: Update Notes v0.3.8
notes.notes:
make it look good [list]
[*] Audio Jack Fix: Resolved an issue where the audio jack stopped working.
[*] Updated Binaries: Upgraded binaries to the latest version for improved stability and performance.
[*] Telemetry Checkbox: Added a checkbox to enable or disable telemetry as needed.
[*] Improved Haptics and Speaker Tests.
[*] Flash Status Check Adjustment: Disabled flash minor status check when not in permanent or temporary mode.
[*] DualSense Edge Support: Added telemetry support for DualSense Edge controllers.
[*] Board Info Update: Returns a hex number for board information when the board is unknown.
[*] Controller Button Fix: Fixed an issue where buttons were not enabled when a controller was connected before launching the app.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes v0.3.7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Xbox Controller Issues: Disabled multiple controller detection to resolve issues with Xbox controllers on certain PCs.
[*] Trigger Position Display Fix: Corrected the display of trigger positions for controllers that don’t support analog triggers.
[*] Retry Mechanism for VID/PID: Added a retry mechanism when fetching VID/PID for controllers.
[*] Calibration Button Changes: Replaced permanent and temporary calibration buttons with Save and Restore buttons.
[*] DualSense Calibration: Fixed calibration data retrieval for DualSense controllers in the controller log.
[*] SN Logging Simplified: Serial number logging is always enabled, so the option has been removed.
[*] Manual Calibration Fixes: Fixed inverted values for range-center in manual calibration.
[*] Warning Text for Manual Calibration: Added red warning text when values hit the limits (0 or 4095) in the manual calibration small boxes.
[*] DualSense Speaker Testing: Controller info is now disabled when testing the DualSense speaker.
[*] UI Adjustments for Calibration: Made small adjustments to how small boxes and canvases work for improved usability.
[*] Launch Bug Fix: Resolved an issue causing the app to freeze and lag on launch on some PCs.
[/list]
